sections.heading: Inner current loop
sections.text: Sense L2 (output inductor) current for the inner loop — this gives direct control of the output dynamics. Bandwidth: f_ci ~ fsw/5 to fsw/10. PI compensator. The inverted output requires sign-inverted feedback or a negative reference in the controller.

sections.heading: Outer voltage loop
sections.text: f_cv < f_RHPZ/4 where f_RHPZ = (1-D)^2*R/(2*pi*L2). Design for worst case: minimum R (max load), maximum D. Start with kp = 2*pi*f_cv*C_out and ki = kp * f_cv / 5. The integrator must be anti-windup clamped because the duty cycle saturates at 0 and 1.

sections.heading: Revision note
sections.text: If the Cuk oscillates at fsw/2, this is subharmonic instability from peak-current-mode — add slope compensation >= inductor downslope / 2. If it cannot meet transient specs in CCM, consider DCM operation or a different topology.
